name: chevrons-right
description: A chevrons right with an open V and round ends.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner explicitly requested larger native None glyphs while retaining the existing smaller Square/Circle glyphs unchanged. Double Chevron None uses local vertices(-8.25,4.125),(0,-4.125),(8.25,4.125), centers-5/+5 along its axis. The primary visible extent is20px. At fixed radius.875 the two Filled heads still touch exactly at the center with no overlap. None geometry is authored separately from frames, with no runtime style/frame scaling and no scaling of stroke width. Rebuild all Filled contours at the fixed source stroke expansion; never scale a previous Filled path. Square/Circle SVG and metadata files retain their previous exact artwork and dimensions. This supersedes the older requirement that None and framed glyphs have identical size. Native X/Y100/100 and rotation0 remain the new None baseline. Revised None glyph awaits owner review; existing frame review status is unchanged.

review.note: Larger native None glyph requested by owner; smaller Square/Circle variants are preserved unchanged. Awaiting owner visual review.
